[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Canteval''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who commanded a [[Canteval's Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] Canteval, under orders from [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], oversaw [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]. Taloraan magister [[Orlin Denache]] had secretly signed a treaty with Dooku, who in turn ordered Canteval and a local CIS supporter [[Rynert]] to begin land [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] within the [[Taloraan City]]. When the fact was discovered by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who accompanied her master [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in their negotiations with the local [[Denfrandi]], Canteval ordered [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to engage the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After issuing the order, Canteval moved his ship into the clouds in the upper levels of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] atmosphere. By the time [[Rynert]]'s men and the CIS forces established control over the city, Canteval developed a plan to ambush the Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] once it would it enter the upper levels of the planet's atmosphere to make contact with the Jedi. The Jedi, however, managed to get a message to ''Resolute'' and warn its commander of the upcoming ambush. Without the element of surprise Canteval's [[Canteval's Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] was unable to overpower the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator]] on its own. With its shield weakening, the Munificent took several direct hits into its engines. Unable to maintain altitude, the ship, with Canteval still aboard, was sucked into the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] core, thus ending his life.
